project.name: Cardigan
project.summary: Kanban app (boards, columns, cards, labels) with a Kotlin Spring Boot backend, a Compose Multiplatform app for Android and iOS, and a responsive React web app.

chunks.title: API contract
chunks.summary: REST contract (e.g. OpenAPI) for auth, boards, columns, cards, labels, ordering and board import/export, including the shared error model and the JSON export format.
chunks.doneWhen: The spec is reviewed, validated by a linter and covers every v1 operation including error responses.

chunks.title: Backend scaffolding & architecture
chunks.summary: Spring Boot (Kotlin) project, package/module layout, Postgres connection (local + Supabase), migration tooling, global error handling, logging, health endpoint, Dockerfile and CI build/test.
chunks.doneWhen: Service boots locally against Postgres with an empty migration, exposes a health endpoint, and CI builds and tests it.

chunks.title: Backend authentication
chunks.summary: Users, registration, login and logout with password hashing, 15-minute JWT access tokens, 30-day refresh tokens with rotation and revocation, and the security filter protecting all other endpoints.
chunks.doneWhen: Integration tests cover register, login, refresh, logout and rejection of expired/revoked tokens, matching the contract.

chunks.title: Backend boards & columns
chunks.summary: Per-user boards and their columns with CRUD, column reordering and ownership scoping.
chunks.doneWhen: Integration tests cover board and column CRUD, column ordering and ownership isolation per the contract.

chunks.title: Backend cards & card ordering
chunks.summary: Cards inside columns with CRUD, moves within a column and across columns, and a position scheme that stays consistent under reordering.
chunks.doneWhen: Integration tests cover card CRUD, same-column and cross-column moves, order consistency and ownership isolation.

chunks.title: Backend labels
chunks.summary: User-defined labels (CRUD) and attaching/detaching labels to cards; cards return their labels.
chunks.doneWhen: Integration tests cover label CRUD, attach/detach and ownership isolation.

chunks.title: Backend board import/export
chunks.summary: Blocking download of a complete board as JSON (columns, cards, labels, order) and blocking upload that validates the file and recreates the board for the current user.
chunks.doneWhen: Round-trip test: an exported board imported into another account is equivalent; invalid files are rejected with contract errors.

chunks.title: VPS infrastructure & deployment
chunks.summary: Provision the production VPS: container runtime, reverse proxy with TLS serving the web build and the API, secrets, Supabase Postgres connection, backups/monitoring basics, and an automated CD pipeline for backend and web.
chunks.doneWhen: A push to main deploys the backend and the web build to production over HTTPS and the health endpoint answers.

chunks.title: Mobile scaffolding & architecture
chunks.summary: Compose Multiplatform project for Android and iOS, module structure, base architecture (MVI, DI), navigation shell, HTTP client base and error model, CI build.
chunks.doneWhen: App launches on Android and iOS with a placeholder screen and navigation shell; CI builds both targets.

chunks.title: Mobile design system
chunks.summary: Theme, tokens (colors, typography, spacing, light/dark) and base components shared by all mobile screens.
chunks.doneWhen: Theme and base components exist with previews and are used by a sample screen on both platforms.

chunks.title: Mobile fake API layer
chunks.summary: Data source interfaces from the contract plus in-memory fakes that model production behavior, including errors, latency and expiring tokens, swappable for the real client later.
chunks.doneWhen: Every contract operation has a fake implementation with tests, selectable via DI.

chunks.title: Mobile authentication
chunks.summary: Register, login and logout screens, secure token storage on Android and iOS, refresh-on-expiry handling, and session-gated navigation.
chunks.doneWhen: Register, login, auto-refresh and logout work end to end against the fake API on both platforms.

chunks.title: Mobile board list
chunks.summary: Board overview: list boards, create, rename and delete, with loading/empty/error states and intentional refresh.
chunks.doneWhen: Board list flows work against the fake API on Android and iOS.

chunks.title: Mobile board view
chunks.summary: Board screen showing columns and cards with layouts per screen size (phone and tablet), column create/rename/delete, column move buttons, and intentional refresh.
chunks.doneWhen: A seeded fake board renders correctly on phone and tablet; column CRUD and move buttons work against the fake API.

chunks.title: Mobile card detail & editing
chunks.summary: Create, view, edit and delete cards; presentation adapts to screen size (e.g. sheet on phones, dialog/side panel on wide screens).
chunks.doneWhen: Card create/edit/delete works from the board view against the fake API on phone and tablet.

chunks.title: Mobile card drag & drop
chunks.summary: Touch drag & drop of cards within and across columns, including auto-scroll, persisting the move and handling failures.
chunks.doneWhen: Cards can be dragged within and across columns on both platforms; the order persists in the fake API and failed moves roll back.

chunks.title: Mobile labels
chunks.summary: Label management (create/edit/delete), attaching labels to cards, and showing labels on cards.
chunks.doneWhen: Labels can be managed and attached to cards against the fake API on both platforms.

chunks.title: Mobile board search & filter
chunks.summary: Client-side text search and label filter over the cards of the open board.
chunks.doneWhen: Searching and filtering by labels narrows the visible cards of the open board without backend calls.

chunks.title: Mobile board import/export
chunks.summary: Export a board as a JSON file and import one via platform file pickers/share sheets on Android and iOS, with blocking progress and error handling.
chunks.doneWhen: Export saves/shares a JSON file and import creates a board from a file, on both platforms against the fake API.

chunks.title: Mobile integration with real backend
chunks.summary: Real HTTP implementations of the data sources, environment/base URL config, real refresh-token flow, and end-to-end verification against production.
chunks.doneWhen: All mobile flows work on Android and iOS against the deployed backend.

chunks.title: Web scaffolding & architecture
chunks.summary: React + TypeScript project, build tooling, routing, data-fetching setup, HTTP client base and error model, responsive app shell, lint/test and CI.
chunks.doneWhen: App builds and runs with a responsive shell and routing; CI lints, tests and produces a static build.

chunks.title: Web design system
chunks.summary: Tokens and responsive base components (buttons, inputs, dialogs, menus, layout primitives) for phone, tablet and desktop widths.
chunks.doneWhen: Base components exist, are documented/previewable and render correctly from phone to desktop widths.

chunks.title: Web fake API layer
chunks.summary: Fake implementation of the contract (in-memory or request mocking) modeling production behavior including errors, latency and token expiry, switchable for the real API.
chunks.doneWhen: Every contract operation is served by the fake layer with tests, toggled by configuration.

chunks.title: Web authentication
chunks.summary: Register, login and logout pages, token handling and refresh-on-expiry, protected routes.
chunks.doneWhen: Register, login, auto-refresh and logout work end to end against the fake API.

chunks.title: Web board list
chunks.summary: Board overview: list boards, create, rename and delete, with loading/empty/error states and intentional refresh.
chunks.doneWhen: Board list flows work against the fake API.

chunks.title: Web board view
chunks.summary: Board screen showing columns and cards with layouts per screen size (phone to desktop widths), column create/rename/delete, column move buttons, and intentional refresh.
chunks.doneWhen: A seeded fake board renders correctly on phone to desktop widths; column CRUD and move buttons work against the fake API.

chunks.title: Web card detail & editing
chunks.summary: Create, view, edit and delete cards; presentation adapts to screen size (e.g. sheet on phones, dialog/side panel on wide screens).
chunks.doneWhen: Card create/edit/delete works from the board view against the fake API on phone to desktop widths.

chunks.title: Web card drag & drop
chunks.summary: Mouse and touch drag & drop of cards within and across columns, persisting moves and rolling back on failure.
chunks.doneWhen: Cards can be dragged within and across columns with mouse and touch; order persists in the fake API and failed moves roll back.

chunks.title: Web labels
chunks.summary: Label management (create/edit/delete), attaching labels to cards, and showing labels on cards.
chunks.doneWhen: Labels can be managed and attached to cards against the fake API.

chunks.title: Web board search & filter
chunks.summary: Client-side text search and label filter over the cards of the open board.
chunks.doneWhen: Searching and filtering by labels narrows the visible cards of the open board without backend calls.

chunks.title: Web board import/export
chunks.summary: Download a board as a JSON file and import one via file upload, with blocking progress and error handling.
chunks.doneWhen: Export downloads a JSON file and import creates a board from it against the fake API.

chunks.title: Web integration with real backend
chunks.summary: Switch from fakes to the real API, environment config, real refresh-token flow (incl. CORS/cookie decisions), and end-to-end verification against production.
chunks.doneWhen: All web flows work against the deployed backend in production.
